# Please allow players to obtain Consecrated Sharpening Stones and Blessed Wizard Oil

## Post 13303 by Qixel (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2021-10-28T18:17:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=13303#p13303 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

During the Naxxramas prerelease event, players could obtain temporary weapon modification items that improved their damage against undead enemies. Players at the time stockpiled them, but over time, that supply has dwindled. Inspired by the zanza potions, I think it would be a good idea to add a repeatable quest to Light's Hope Chapel that requires exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn, trading in an argent dawn valor token in exchange for the player's choice of a consecrated sharpening stone or a blessed wizard oil. This would give players both new and old a sustainable source of these consumables as well as encourage more interest in Scholomance and Stratholme from players who otherwise would not have anything to gain from it.

Admittedly, it's been a while since I designed a quest, so apologies in advance if I forgot anything, aha. [The Long Night Is Not Over](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) is obtained from Quartermaster Miranda Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, although if you guys would prefer to have the quest be offered by someone else, feel free. I just figured the quartermaster would be an obvious pick. :3

It's unavailable before exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn, and is flagged as repeatable and turned in upon being accepted, which I assume will function similarly to the Zanza's Potent Potables quest. If I'm wrong, and I've a history of it, you can take the last line of the quest and use it as the completion text, probably. <3
